votes.motion: Commissioner Squire motioned to approve the Draper City Planning Commission Minutes from September 10, 2020
Commissioner Player motioned to approve the Planning Commission Minutes for September 24, 2020

Commissioner Van Hoff motioned to approve the Site Plan as requested by Drew Parcell representing DC Joint Ventures for Draper Cove Phase 3 Applications SPR-1035- 2020. Based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the Staff Report dated November 9, 2020

Commissioner Van Hoff motioned to approve the Plat Amendment Plan as requested by Drew Parcell representing DC Joint Ventures for Draper Cove Phase 3 Applications SUBD-1036-2020. Based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the Staff Report dated November 9, 2020
Commissioner Player motioned for a recess until 7:45 p.m. for Mr. Barker to check on the rules

Commissioner Van Hoff motioned to not continue the item. Ms. Jastremsky clarified there are three option available- approval, denial, or continue. Chairman Adams stated if they do not continue they have to approve or deny the application. Ms. Jastremsky stated there is a fourth option which would be to not put forth a motion so there is no action on the item and the applicant can withdraw. Ms. Oliver stated if the applicant wants to withdraw right now, there should not be Planning Commission motion on this item. Chairman Adams asked Mr. Bodrero what he wants to do
